importModeNotes: ImportMode is a plain (non-nullable) property on ManualImportCommand with no default set at declaration and no [Optional]/nullable annotation, so JSON deserialization leaves it at the enum's default ordinal (0 = Auto) if omitted from the request body - it is not strictly REQUIRED for the request to be accepted, but omitting it silently selects Auto rather than failing. The plan should send it explicitly rather than relying on the implicit default. 'Move' (1) is Sonarr's typical value for the standard manual-import-from-download-client flow (moves the file out of the download client's directory into the library, consistent with Sonarr's own default download-client post-processing behavior); 'Copy' (2) leaves the source in place; 'Auto' (0) defers to Sonarr's own per-download-client Move/Copy preference. Recommend the plan send 'Move' explicitly to match existing non-AI import behavior in this codebase, but this recommendation is inferred from source/enum semantics only - it was not verified by an actual live call in this session (that call is explicitly out of scope for Step 0).
